#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long p, k;
const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
long long w[1000100];

long long mod_pow(long long base, long long exp)
{
    long long result = 1;
    while (exp > 0)
    {
        if (exp & 1) result = result * base % MOD;
        base = base * base % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main()
{
    cin >> p >> k;
    if (k == 1)
    {
        cout << mod_pow(p, p) << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    for (long long i = 1; i < p; i++)
    {
        w[i] = (k * i) % p;
    }

    int count = 0;
    bool visited[1000100];
    memset(visited, false, sizeof(visited));

    for (int i = 1; i < p; i++)
    {
        if (visited[i]) continue;
        int t = i;
        while (!visited[t])
        {
            visited[t] = true;
            t = w[t];
        }
        count++;
    }
    cout << mod_pow(p, count) << endl;
    return 0;
}
